# kkp_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by ID or name. With neither set, it returns the provider's default project (for a service account token, the token's project).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider's default project (for a service account token, the token's project).
data "kkp_project" "current" {}

data "kkp_project" "by_name" {
  name = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Must match exactly one project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `owners` (List of String) Owner e-mail addresses.
- `status` (String)
